description: Find US wholesale, dropship and closeout suppliers on WholesaleCentral.com by keyword, live category, or supplier URL. Filter by state, minimum order, keyword, or featured placement.

categories.description: Crawl up to 10 live category slugs in one run, e.g. ["Apparel", "Electronics", "Pet-Supplies"]. Values must come from the `category` list. Overrides `category`; `customCategorySlug` is ignored when this is set.
categories.title: Categories (multi-category crawl)

category.description: One of the 54 live top-level supplier categories (mode=byCategory). Use `categories` to crawl several at once, or `customCategorySlug` for a narrower sub-category.
category.title: Category

customCategorySlug.description: Use any narrower WholesaleCentral.com category slug, e.g. `Mens-Apparel` or `Apparel-Dropshippers`. Overrides `category`; leave empty to use the live dropdown list.
customCategorySlug.title: Custom category slug (advanced)

featuredOnly.description: Only include suppliers the directory badges as a Featured (premium/paid) listing.
featuredOnly.title: Featured listings only

includeDetails.description: Read each supplier page for phone, full address, website, description, social links, postal code, and product-catalog summary. Turn off for the fastest listing-only run.
includeDetails.title: Fetch supplier detail pages

includeEmbeddedContact.description: Opt in to business email addresses and extra phone/fax numbers that the site embeds in the supplier page payload but does not display. Off by default. Review your privacy and outreach obligations before enabling.
includeEmbeddedContact.title: Include embedded email/extra phones

includeProductSummary.description: When details are fetched, include productCount, categoryCounts, collectionsCount, sampleProducts, and shipsFrom. No extra request is made.
includeProductSummary.title: Include product-catalog summary

keyword.description: Only include suppliers whose name or description contains this text (case-insensitive).
keyword.title: Keyword filter

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted supplier records. Each category is additionally capped at 100 cards.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxMinimumOrderUSD.description: Only include suppliers whose minimum order is at most this amount. Suppliers with no disclosed minimum are always included.
maxMinimumOrderUSD.title: Max minimum order (USD)

mode.description: How to discover suppliers. `search` uses the supplier-only search tab; `bySupplier` refreshes a known list of supplier URLs/slugs.
mode.title: Mode

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor connects directly first and automatically picks a working Apify connection if the site blocks it; you do not need to configure anything.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

searchQuery.description: Keyword search over supplier names/profiles (mode=search), e.g. `candles` or `bluetooth speakers`. Required in search mode.
searchQuery.title: Search query

state.description: Keep suppliers in one US state. Accepts a full name or two-letter code (`NY`, `New York`, `California`). Matches the state exactly; it never matches a city substring.
state.title: US state filter

supplierUrls.description: Full supplier URLs, paths, or slugs to refresh, e.g. ["https://www.wholesalecentral.com/suppliers/fourse0001"]. Duplicates are removed.
supplierUrls.title: Supplier URLs (mode=bySupplier)

title: US Wholesale Supplier Directory Scraper Input
